chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Munich, 2006, the first game of the World Cup! Germany's left-back, Philipp Lahm, has the ball wide on the left. The defender slips! Lahm cuts inside... curls it... Goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it again, from behind. One sharp cut puts it on his right foot. It starts outside the far post, then bends back in.

chapters.label: From behind the goal
chapters.text: From behind the goal: the keeper leaps, but it's too high! Top corner!

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: The secret? Full-backs can attack too! Cut inside onto your stronger foot, then curl it into the far corner.
